10.comment: Tate caught three of five targets for 27 yards in the Titans' 24-20 loss to the Eagles on Sunday.

10.name: Joey Slye
10.comment: Slye made both of his field-goal attempts and each of his two extra-point tries during the Titans' 24-20 loss to the Eagles on Sunday.

10.name: Tony Pollard
10.comment: Pollard carried the ball 14 times for 64 yards and caught his only target for one yard in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Eagles.

10.name: Cam Ward
10.comment: Ward completed 13 of 20 passes for 183 yards without a touchdown or interception in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Eagles. He added seven rushing yards and two TDs on four carries.

10.name: Fernando Carmona
10.comment: Carmona suffered a shoulder injury during Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Eagles, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

10.name: Micah Robinson
10.comment: With Cor'Dale Flott (quadriceps) inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Robinson will start at outside cornerback opposite Alontae Taylor, Paul Kuharsky of PaulKuharsky.com reports.

10.name: Cedric Gray
10.comment: Gray (concussion) does not have an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Eagles.

10.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
10.comment: Winston posted 10 tackles (four solo) during the Titans' 23-10 loss to the Jets on Sunday.

10.name: Amani Hooker
10.comment: Hooker logged 10 tackles (six solo) during the Titans' 23-10 loss to the Jets on Sunday.

10.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
10.comment: Hill recorded 16 tackles (two solo) and two pass defenses during the Titans' 23-10 loss to the Jets on Sunday.

10.name: Chimere Dike
10.comment: Dike recorded one catch for seven yards, three kickoff returns for 62 yards and one punt return for minus-5 yards in Sunday's 23-10 loss to the Jets.

10.name: Daniel Bellinger
10.comment: Bellinger caught his sole target for seven yards in Sunday's 23-10 loss to the Jets.

28.name: Ben Sinnott
28.comment: Sinnott caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Dyami Brown
28.comment: Brown caught four of his six targets for 21 yards and completed his sole pass attempt for zero yards while losing one fumble in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Antonio Williams
28.comment: Williams caught all three of his targets for 24 yards and went 0-for-1 passing in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Kaytron Allen
28.comment: Allen logged five carries for 24 yards in the last 3:01 of Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Brandon Coleman
28.comment: Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that "all signs look good to go" regarding Coleman's odds of being available in Week 3, JP Finlay of NBC Sports Washington reports.

28.name: Sam Cosmi
28.comment: Cosmi suffered a concussion in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Commanders, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

28.name: Drew Stevens
28.comment: Stevens made two of his three field-goal attempts while converting both PATs in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Nick Cross
28.comment: Cross (undisclosed) stayed in Dallas overnight Sunday due to an internal injury, and his status for Week 3 against the Seahawks is up in the air, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.

28.name: Javon Kinlaw
28.comment: Head coach Dan Quinn told reporters Monday that Kinlaw will have an MRI for a shoulder injury, JP Finlay of NBC Sports Washington reports.

28.name: Jayden Daniels
28.comment: Daniels (elbow) underwent imaging Monday and will consult with multiple experts over the next few days, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

28.name: Marcus Mariota
28.comment: Mariota is expected to start Sunday's game against Seattle while the Commanders continue to gather more information on the severity of Jayden Daniels' dislocated left elbow, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

28.name: Frankie Luvu
28.comment: out

28.name: Chig Okonkwo
28.comment: out

28.name: Rachaad White
28.comment: White rushed seven times for 43 yards and brought in all six targets for 40 yards in the Commanders' 37-20 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

28.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
28.comment: Croskey-Merritt rushed 12 times for 43 yards and brought in his only target for five yards in the Commanders' 37-20 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.

28.name: Terry McLaurin
28.comment: McLaurin brought in two of nine targets for 50 yards in the Commanders' 37-20 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

28.name: Stefon Diggs
28.comment: Diggs caught five of six targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in the Commanders' 37-20 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

28.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
28.comment: Kaliakmanis (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Commanders' emergency third quarterback against the Cowboys on Sunday.

28.name: Luke McCaffrey
28.comment: McCaffrey (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

28.name: John Bates
28.comment: Bates should take on an elevated role against the Cowboys on Sunday after Chig Okonkwo was ruled out due to a hamstring injury.

28.name: Odafe Oweh
28.comment: Oweh (calf) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game at Dallas.

28.name: K'Lavon Chaisson
28.comment: Chaisson (knee) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game at Dallas.
